item.title: Coherence Engineering in Semiconductor Spin Qubits
item.description:
An invited talk covering our recent results on coherence engineering in Si/SiGe double quantum dots, including the dependence of $T_2^*$ on isotopic purification and the trade-off against valley splitting.

This entry demonstrates everything at once: captions, tags, prose, and a multi-photo grid.
